decision.reason: [ev-ce832d0081c5] is a single changelog line saying that Loki now shards quantile_over_time range queries using probabilistic data structures, and it points to PR 10417. It does not say whether the behaviour is on by default or controlled by a flag or config option, so applicability can't be determined. It also does not say what an exposed environment would see, for example approximate instead of exact quantile results, or different performance. The PR or the query-sharding documentation is needed to say whether this is gated, what its default is, and how query results change.
